original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 0 BIOS Version exactly matches the approved firmware recipe and remains unchanged after reboot.
original_method: Archive raw Type 0 and the explicit BIOS Version on the mapped SUT, compare it with the approved image/build value, perform the approved software reboot, repeat the identical query and compare context and health.
manual_activity: A user approves the unchanged plan and expected build. Collection, exact comparison, reboot and post-check are software-controlled; the final verdict remains engineer-owned.
required_inputs: Expected BIOS Version including build/revision normalization
safety_requirements: Do not discard stderr or treat a grep match as the authoritative record.
Preserve raw Type 0 and tool versions before extracting BIOS Version.
Stop on wrong SUT/image mapping, version drift, boot failure or management loss.
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw Type 0/tool/platform evidence, run the approved reboot and compare exact BIOS Version before/after.
Flag mismatches without reflashing, normalizing unsupported differences or deciding PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected build string, comparison normalization and reboot/recovery.
Interpret any mismatch and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: dmidecode -t 0 is correct, but 2>/dev/null and grep-only evidence can hide access/table errors; sshpass with disabled host-key checking is not an approved default.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved transport; archive dmidecode --version and full sudo dmidecode -t 0 output, then extract Version without discarding errors, before and after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The linked script, BIOS Version field and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare raw Type 0 Version against the exact deployed BIOS image/build manifest and repeat after reboot with identical tooling and SUT identity.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record dmidecode, SMBIOS, BIOS build and kernel versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Installed dmidecode documentation and approved firmware release manifest.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds image provenance, full error-visible output and deterministic comparison.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected image/build and accepted string representation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some vendors format a build differently from package filename; the allowed mapping must be explicit.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a specific build or normalized display string. It must record the mapping and cannot silently replace the master expectation.
expected_evidence: Approval, image manifest, SUT identity and dmidecode version
Raw pre-reboot Type 0 plus extracted Version
Raw post-reboot output and exact diff
